client_entity.description: Legal name of the target entity (Layer 0)

source_document.description: GCS path or document name this graph was extracted from

nodes.description: All ownership entities extracted from this document. Ownership relationship data lives on edges.

id.description: Slug: lowercase entity name with spaces replaced by underscores.

name.description: Legal name exactly as stated in the document.

layer.description: 0 = Client, 1 = direct owners, 2 = owners of layer 1, etc.

ownership_chain.description: Full path of entity ids from the target entity (layer 0) to this node. E.g. layer-0 node: ["target_id"], layer-2 node: ["target_id", "layer1_owner_id", "this_node_id"].

classification_reasoning.description: Full classification trace: why this entity is an owner (not a subsidiary), how the layer was determined, entity type reasoning, and the document page/section that evidences it.

edges.description: All ownership relationships extracted from this document.

owner.description: id of the entity that holds the ownership stake.

owned.description: id of the entity being owned.

ownership_percentage_direct.description: Exact % as stated in the document, or 'Not Available' if missing.

control.description: Evidence of control (voting rights, board rights, etc.) or null.

source.description: Exact document name and page/section where this relationship is evidenced.

direction_proof.description: Why this edge direction is correct: which entity holds shares in which, and the document page/section that proves it.

cycle_path.description: Entity ids forming the cycle, starting and ending at the repeated node.

source.description: Source document where the cycle was detected.

conflicts.description: Ownership % conflicts found within this document.

resolved_value.description: The value Wave 5 should use. Derived by applying resolution_strategy to value_a and value_b.
